 ShopeeVIP+ Adds YouTube Premium Lite in the PH
 By Wazzup.PH - November 14, 2026 0 274 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 ShopeeVIP+ subscribers in Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines can now enjoy fewer ads with YouTube Premium Lite alongside Netflix access, free shipping with no minimum spend, daily 20% discount vouchers and more–all in one subscription. 
 Building on the momentum of ShopeeVIP+, Shopee has announced the latest addition to its “Shopping meets Streaming with One subscription, more ways to stream!” offering: YouTube Premium Lite .
 Starting November 11, ShopeeVIP+ subscribers in Indonesia, Thailand, and the Philippines can enjoy both YouTube Premium Lite and Netflix at no extra cost beyond their existing ShopeeVIP+ subscription fee.
 With YouTube Premium Lite, ShopeeVIP+ members can enjoy the following benefits:
 Watch their favorite videos with fewer ads. 
 Download most videos for offline viewing , even without mobile data or Wi-Fi.
 Keep most videos playing in the background while using other apps or when their device screen is locked.
 Existing ShopeeVIP+ members can activate YouTube Premium Lite through the Shopee app or by using the activation link sent via email or SMS beginning November 11, with no additional charge.
 This latest addition further strengthens the value of ShopeeVIP+ for Filipino consumers. Beyond the products they purchase, online shoppers also look for convenience, delivery savings, and value for money. ShopeeVIP+ is designed to address these needs by bringing together shopping perks and entertainment in one membership.
 With YouTube Premium Lite joining Netflix access, free shipping on every order, and an exclusive 20% discount voucher every day, ShopeeVIP+ combines shopping, savings, and entertainment in a single subscription.
 Jack Ng, Head of Commercial at Shopee Philippines , said, “At Shopee, our goal is for ShopeeVIP+ to bring greater value and convenience to more parts of Filipinos’ everyday lives. Adding YouTube Premium Lite advances that goal by giving subscribers fewer ads and greater flexibility to enjoy content throughout the day. This partnership reflects our commitment to growing the program by adding benefits that matter to how Filipinos shop, watch, and unwind.”
 Upgraded Perks in One ShopeeVIP+ Subscription Bundle 
 A single ShopeeVIP+ subscription brings together shopping benefits, Netflix, and YouTube Premium Lite at no additional cost. This gives members a more convenient and affordable way to enjoy both streaming services compared with subscribing to them separately.
 ShopeeVIP+ subscription benefits include:
 YouTube Premium Lite Access: Enjoy YouTube with fewer ads, offline video downloads, and background play.
 Netflix Access: Stream your favorite series and movies on Netflix, the world’s leading entertainment service. Subscribers can also watch popular Filipino titles such as Ganito, Ganyan, Ganoon, 18th Rose, Call Me Mother, Someone, Someday, and The Master Cutter .
 Free Shipping Vouchers With No Minimum Spend: Enjoy free shipping vouchers on every order, with no minimum spend required, for a more convenient and cost-effective shopping experience.
 Exclusive 20% Discount Every Day: Get an exclusive 20% discount voucher every day.
 Priority Customer Service: Enjoy access to 24/7 priority customer service.
 Choosing Your ShopeeVIP+ Plan 
 ShopeeVIP+ subscriptions start at PHP 140 per month for a multi-month subscription plan and PHP 169 per month for a single-month subscription plan. With flexible subscription options, users can choose the plan that best suits their needs.
 Subscribers can access ShopeeVIP+ benefits, including YouTube Premium Lite and Netflix, through a simple sign-up process in the Shopee app:
 Open the Shopee app on your device.
 On the homepage, select the ShopeeVIP icon.
 Choose the ShopeeVIP+ subscription package.
 Make sure you have selected your preferred plan.
 Tap “Subscribe” and select your preferred subscription period.
 Complete the payment using one of the available payment methods.
 Once the payment is successful, you will receive a notification confirming your ShopeeVIP+ membership.
 Activate your YouTube Premium Lite benefit through the app or by using the activation link sent via email or SMS.
 Existing ShopeeVIP+ subscribers can also activate their YouTube Premium Lite benefit directly in the Shopee app by following Step 8.
 During the Shopee 11.11 Big Sale , ShopeeVIP+ members can look forward to even more exciting promotions, including ShopeeVIP’s 11.11 Shake , where participants have a chance to win up to 1,111 coins .
 Join ShopeeVIP+ and enjoy a range of lifestyle benefits in one convenient subscription. For more information, visit https://shopee.ph/vip-plus . Download the Shopee app for free through the App Store or Google Play.
